scope: 76-point financial, valuation and timing subset; not full live QVT, sector normalization or live buy_review/risk policy
financial_cutoff: Strictly before signal-day opening, historical Asia/Tehran zone rules
decision_time_contract: Date-based end-of-session signal after official closing evidence; financial/share cutoff is conservative signal-day midnight, not the timestamp of the trading decision
financial_freshness: Current financial period at most 365 calendar days old; reject fallback to an older income report when a newer reported income period exists
roe: net_profit_ttm / end-period parent equity, matching live roe_level; no average-equity substitution
shares: Only an existing KNOWN valid-time interval, knowledge_from <= cutoff, matching company and security identity; no nominal capital inference
price: Latest strictly positive raw traded official close <= decision date and at most seven calendar days old; shares interval must cover both price date and decision date
normalization: Same complete eligible population for every factor/strategy; current P1/P99 midrank, margins 60/40; no missing fill or weight redistribution
six_month_schedule: First eligible decision, then first eligible observed decision at least six Gregorian calendar months later; no optimized starting month
monthly_schedule: Each eligible observed decision; absent observations cause holding, never invented decisions
accounting: Certified rebalance_accounts reused, global next traded session execution, exact-day positive-volume gate, failed targets cash, non-executable holdings carried, common final mark with no final rebalance
outcome: Actual elapsed days CAGR; daily marked drawdown also reported; price with mechanical adjustment, no complete dividends or queue guarantee
evaluation: Fixed descriptive time slices 2022-2023, 2024, 2025-2026; all historically observed before, no untouched holdout or parameter optimization
limitations: Historical universe/model family use current identities, survivorship bias unresolved
Historical industry map absent, family ranking only
Financial history reconstructed today from originally dated publications, not historical first-seen logs
Existing corporate action and share chains reused; source classification not independently recertified
Remaining missing and rejected reports limit representativeness
No live brokerage orders or optimization of weights
